game: NE @ CIN Week 12 2025, kickoff 2025-11-23 13:00 ET, outdoor, CIN +7.5, total 50.5

script.base: NE (Drake Maye, TreVeyon Henderson) is the -7.5 favorite with a 29.0 implied total and should lead by about a score, then lean run late on a 50.5 total that still implies plenty of plays. CIN, Joe Burrow out and Joe Flacco in (already the weeks 8/9/11 sample), implied 21.5, trails and throws to Ja'Marr Chase (37 targets, 232 yards L3) and Tee Higgins while Chase Brown keeps a dual role.
script.flip1: NE is up 17+ by half: Henderson's carries stack early but Maye/WR late yards stall, and CIN abandons the run so Brown's rush line dies while Chase/Higgins targets and Brown checkdowns rise.
script.flip2: Flacco keeps CIN within a score or ahead: both sides throw, Henderson's clock-killing carries shrink toward 10-12, and the CIN WR overs plus Brown's receiving half become the path to the total.

pre_mortem: It's Monday and both lost. Henderson: Stevenson was active, took the first- and second-down work on a toe that held up, NE scripted Maye into empty early, and Henderson finished under 8 carries in a game that never became the clock-kill. Brown: Perine played, NE's 4.00 YPC front stuffed the run like the 37-yard game, and Flacco did not check down (the -8 receiving game), so the two failures that have been separate in the last4 showed up together and 68.5 never got a path. The missing inactives list and the missing weather (outdoor, forecast not saved) are the other ways this read was blind. If those counters are how the game sets up, the Brown lean is the first drop; Henderson's counter has to be a full role reversal, which the weeks 9-11 log does not show.
slip_story: One story only: NE's offense is good enough to lead and run, and CIN's feature back still produces all-purpose yards while chasing 21.5 with Flacco. Henderson rush over is the favorite-runs-late leg; Brown rush+rec over is the dog-checkdown leg, not a CIN rush-over. Do not pair this with a game under, and do not add Chase or Higgins overs — that would be a second, pass-script story. No TD legs, no second market on either player. Not a slip to place: prices and inactives are unconfirmed.
